metadata.title: Pass 3 parameter table for the reduced 3D anteroposterior shell coupling and the intracellular Stokes nucleus model of Drosophila ventral furrow formation
metadata.note: Values marked approximate are order-of-magnitude literature values used as model inputs, not digitised measurements; DOIs marked doi_verified_offline=false could not be re-checked without network access and are given as recorded in the cited reference lists.

sources.citation: He B, Doubrovinski K, Polyakov O, Wieschaus E (2014). Apical constriction drives tissue-scale hydrodynamic flow to mediate cell elongation. Nature 508(7496):392-396.
sources.used_for: Passive-tracer behaviour of nuclei in the apically driven cytoplasmic flow; viscous (Stokes) regime of the cytoplasm

sources.citation: Conte V, Munoz JJ, Baum B, Miodownik M (2012). Biomechanical analysis of ventral furrow formation in Drosophila melanogaster. PLoS ONE 7(11):e49973.
sources.used_for: 2D cross-sectional driving depth D_2D(t) and ectodermal pushing

sources.citation: Sweeton D, Parks S, Costa M, Wieschaus E (1991). Gastrulation in Drosophila: the formation of the ventral furrow and posterior midgut invaginations. Development 112(3):775-789.
sources.used_for: Ventral furrow AP extent along the egg length and the timing of germband extension relative to furrow closure (approximate)

sources.citation: Leptin M, Grunewald B (1990). Cell shape changes during gastrulation in Drosophila. Development 110(1):73-84.
sources.used_for: Mesoderm primordium AP extent and the ~500 um egg length (approximate)

sources.citation: Lye CM, Blanchard GB, Naylor HW, Muresan L, Huisken J, Adams RJ, Sanson B (2015). Mechanical coupling between endoderm invagination and axis extension in Drosophila. PLoS Biology 13(11):e1002292.
sources.used_for: Existence of tissue-scale AP tension during germband extension (magnitude NOT calibrated here; ell_N is a swept model parameter)

egg_geometry.mesoderm_ap_extent_note: approximate twist/snail mesoderm primordium span in egg-length units (0 = posterior pole, 1 = anterior pole); Leptin & Grunewald 1990, Sweeton et al. 1991
egg_geometry.reference_furrow_half_depth_extent_note: approximate: the furrow spans essentially the whole mesoderm primordium (~0.65 EL); not a digitised measurement

ap_shell_line_model.equation: ell_B^4 D'''' - ell_N^2 D'' + k_rel(z) D = D_2D(t) chi_meso(z);  k_rel = (kappa_z^2 + kappa_theta^2)(z) / (kappa_z^2 + kappa_theta^2)(0)
ap_shell_line_model.bending_length_note: model assumption (Winkler bending boundary-layer length of the blastoderm epithelium); not measured in the source papers
ap_shell_line_model.germband_tension_note: model assumption for the WT run; ell_N = sqrt(N_GB / k_eq) is swept 0-150 um as the parameter-expressivity axis and is NOT calibrated to Lye et al. 2015 ablation recoil (open Pass 4 item)
ap_shell_line_model.gbe_onset_note: germband extension begins as the ventral furrow closes (~9 min after furrow onset in a 12 min run); Sweeton et al. 1991 (approximate)

intracellular_stokes_model.equation: 4 d_xy[mu psi_xy] + (d_xx - d_yy)[mu (psi_xx - psi_yy)] = 0 on [-w/2, w/2] x [0, h], u = psi_y, v = -psi_x
intracellular_stokes_model.nucleus_geometry_note: approximate cellular-blastoderm nuclear size and apical position; order-of-magnitude values, not digitised from He et al. 2014
intracellular_stokes_model.viscosity_ratio_note: nearly rigid inclusion limit; He et al. 2014 treat the nucleus as a passive body carried by the cytoplasm
intracellular_stokes_model.reference_passive_tracer_note: He et al. 2014 Fig. 2: nuclei and cytoplasmic markers move together, i.e. v_nucleus / v_cytoplasm ~ 1
